name: PrintableTools Lab Upload Error Cheatsheet
purpose: Machine-readable reference for common PDF, image, JPG, PNG, resume, and email attachment upload errors with direct free no-signup fixes.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 1MB
entries.problem: A job, school, email, or admin portal rejects a PDF by file size.
entries.response: Open the PDF compressor with the 1MB target, compress locally, then review readability before submitting.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 100KB
entries.problem: A tiny exam, school, or form upload cap rejects a PDF above 100KB.
entries.response: Use the strictest 100KB PDF upload-error page and review readability before submitting.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 200KB
entries.problem: A strict portal allows only a very small scanned PDF or short form.
entries.response: Use the severe 200KB PDF upload-error page for short scanned forms and keep the original nearby.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 300KB
entries.problem: A form, application, or admin portal requires a strict PDF cap below 300KB.
entries.response: Use the 300KB PDF upload-error page when the portal allows a little more detail than 100KB or 200KB.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A strict form, exam upload, or school portal requires a very small PDF.
entries.response: Use the strict 500KB PDF target and keep the original file in case the compressed copy loses detail.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 10MB
entries.problem: An email, support, or document portal still rejects a large scanned PDF.
entries.response: Use the 10MB PDF upload-error page for wider caps that still reject very large scans.

entries.errorText: Image must be less than 2MB
entries.problem: A profile, marketplace, support, or application page rejects an image over 2MB.
entries.response: Use the image-to-KB compressor with a 2048KB custom target.

entries.errorText: Image must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A portal or ticket form requires an image below 500KB.
entries.response: Use the 500KB image target, then resize if a large phone photo still misses the limit.

entries.errorText: Photo must be under 100KB
entries.problem: A job, profile, school, or ID-style form rejects a photo by KB size.
entries.response: Use the 100KB image target and check that the face or document text remains clear.

entries.errorText: US passport photo must be 2 x 2 inches
entries.problem: A passport-style workflow needs a square 2 x 2 inch photo before final official review.
entries.response: Use the US 2 x 2 inch crop helper, export locally, then compare the result with the current official photo rules.

entries.errorText: US visa photo must be 600 x 600 px and under 240KB
entries.problem: A visa-style digital upload expects a square photo and rejects files over a fixed KB cap.
entries.response: Resize to 600 x 600 pixels first, then compress the square image toward a custom 240KB target if needed.

entries.errorText: UK digital passport photo rejected
entries.problem: A UK digital passport-style upload rejects the prepared image by crop, size, format, or quality.
entries.response: Prepare the UK-style crop locally, then review the downloaded image against the current GOV.UK digital-photo rules.

entries.errorText: Canada passport photo must be 50 x 70 mm
entries.problem: A Canada-style passport photo workflow needs a 50 x 70 mm crop before final official review.
entries.response: Use the Canada 50 x 70 mm crop helper, export locally, then compare the result with current official instructions.

entries.errorText: Australia passport photo must be 35 x 45 mm
entries.problem: An Australia-style passport photo workflow needs a 35 x 45 mm preparation crop before official checks.
entries.response: Use the Australia-style crop helper locally, then compare the output with current official passport-photo guidance.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: An exam, job, or application portal combines exact photo dimensions with a very small file cap.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 20KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A photo upload box validates both exact 200 x 230 pixel dimensions and a small KB limit.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress toward 50KB if the resized output is still too large.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A profile, exam, or application form requires 200 x 230 pixels with a 100KB cap.
entries.response: Create the exact 200 x 230 image, then use the 100KB image target only if needed.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 240 x 320 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A portrait photo upload requires exact 240 x 320 pixels and rejects files above 50KB.
entries.response: Resize to 240 x 320 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 50KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 295 x 413 px and under 35KB
entries.problem: A portrait photo upload requires exact 295 x 413 pixels and rejects files above 35KB.
entries.response: Resize to 295 x 413 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 35KB.

entries.errorText: JPG must be under 200KB
entries.problem: A portal accepts JPG/JPEG but rejects the image as too large.
entries.response: Use the 200KB image target and keep output as JPG if the destination requires it.

entries.errorText: PNG screenshot too large
entries.problem: A support ticket, admin upload, or bug report rejects a PNG screenshot.
entries.response: Crop private areas first, then compress toward 500KB and review small UI text.

entries.errorText: Invalid file type. Please upload JPG or PNG
entries.problem: A website rejects the current image format and asks for JPG/JPEG/PNG.
entries.response: Convert the image format locally, then compress if the converted file is still too large.

entries.errorText: PDF not accepted, JPG required
entries.problem: A form accepts images but rejects a PDF upload.
entries.response: Convert PDF pages to JPG/PNG locally and upload the page image the destination expects.

entries.errorText: Resume PDF too large
entries.problem: A job application or recruiter portal rejects a resume PDF by size.
entries.response: Try the 1MB PDF target and confirm all resume text remains readable before applying.

entries.errorText: Email attachment too large
entries.problem: Gmail, Outlook, school email, or work mail rejects a document attachment.
entries.response: Compress PDFs toward 5MB or use the image-to-KB tool for photo attachments.

safeUseRules: Share the clean landing page or tracked campaign URL only where it directly answers an upload-error problem.
Do not claim guaranteed compression results; say the tools try toward the target and users should review the output.
Do not ask users to click ads, interact with ads, or upload private files into public examples.
